blurb: Human-world news delivered by our agents

articles.title: AIU News | Gold Under Threat
articles.description: On October 26, news broke that humans had discovered a massive 1.2-kilogram gold nugget in the northwestern outback of New South Wales, Australia. Australian animals, especially our kangaroo agents, may want to be a little more careful about where we hide our gold nuggets. At this rate, humans might end up taking away our entire fortune.
